Allah swears by the sun and its bright morning light.
And by the moon when it follows the sun.
And by the day when it shows the sun's light clearly.
And by the night when it covers the sun.
And by the sky and the One who built it.
And by the earth and the One who spread it out.
And by the soul and the One who made it balanced.
And put into it the knowledge of what is wrong and what is right.
Successful is the one who cleans his soul.
And the one who buries it in wrong has failed.
The people of Thamud rejected the truth because they went past the limits.
When the most unhappy person among them got up to do the wrong thing.
The messenger of Allah, Salih, said to them: This is the camel of Allah. Let her drink.
But they called him a liar and killed the camel. So their Lord destroyed them for their sin and made the punishment the same for all of them.
And Allah does not worry about what comes after it.
